name: Utility SCADA and automatic generation control integration
description: Utility SCADA and automatic generation control integration for the 7-unit gas-engine generator plant and SESB 132/33/11 kV connection. Procurement / I&C. BOQ quantities and dimensions are design inputs, not sourced facts.
aliases: Utility SCADA and automatic generation control integration

specifications.metric: SESB SLDC Automatic Generation Control — AGC command signal
specifications.basis: Sabah Grid Code CC5.3.5 (published 2024, read via r.jina.ai): 'The AGC command shall be sent via the transmittal of a "desired generation output level" signal from the SLDC and the plant controller will adjust the Generating Unit s output accordingly.' (value: desired generation output level signal sent from SLDC to plant controller)

specifications.metric: SESB SLDC Automatic Generation Control — AGC participation requirement
specifications.basis: Sabah Grid Code CC5.3.5 (published 2024, read via r.jina.ai): 'Unless otherwise specified by the GSO, all Generating Units shall be equipped with appropriate plant controllers to participate in this AGC function.' (value: all Generating Units shall be equipped with appropriate plant controllers to par)

specifications.metric: SESB SLDC Automatic Generation Control — secondary reserve (AGC/manual dispatch) response
specifications.unit: seconds realisable; sustainable for next 30 minutes
specifications.basis: Sabah Grid Code OC3.4.1 (published 2024, read via r.jina.ai): 'Secondary Reserve: ... under automatic generation control (AGC) or manually dispatch by GSO ... realisable within thirty (30) seconds ... sustainable for the next thirty (30) minutes.'

specifications.metric: SESB SLDC Automatic Generation Control — primary reserve (free governor) response
specifications.unit: seconds realisable; sustainable for next 25 seconds
specifications.basis: Sabah Grid Code OC3.4.1 (published 2024, read via r.jina.ai): 'Primary Reserve ... realisable within five (5) seconds ... sustainable for the next twenty-five (25) seconds.'

specifications.metric: SESB SLDC Automatic Generation Control — pre-COD AGC test requirement
specifications.basis: Sabah Grid Code OC10 test list (published 2024, read via r.jina.ai): 'Before the Commercial Operation Date (COD), Generator and Power Park Module shall conduct the following tests ... x. Automatic Generation Control'. (value: Automatic Generation Control listed among tests before Commercial Operation Date)

specifications.metric: SESB SLDC Automatic Generation Control — operational metering to SCADA
specifications.basis: Sabah Grid Code MC4.1.2 (published 2024, read via r.jina.ai): 'Operational Metering Data shall be collected by the Remote Terminal Units (RTUs) which are part of the GSO 's SCADA system.' (value: voltage, current, frequency, active/reactive power, plant status indications and)

specifications.metric: Omterra (formerly Siemens Energy) Omni — SCADA role
specifications.basis: Omterra Omnivise T3000 product page, © 2026 Omterra, read directly: 'a scalable SCADA system ... combine all types of generation units by centralized process control' and FAQ 'The Omnivise T3000 system supports easy remote access for remote operation and maintenance.' (value: controls mixed fleet generation from single platform; supports centralized remot)

sources.note: 958 MW CCGT with Omnivise T3000; up to 200 starts per year stated; IEC 62443 compliance.

gaps.what: Integration to SESB SCADA System incl Auto Generation Control System
gaps.why: No evidence found for the protocol actually used between this plant and SESB SLDC (IEC 60870-5-104, DNP3, IEC 61850 or proprietary), RTU model, point count, AGC test results, or integration price.
gaps.next_action: Obtain the SESB SCADA/AGC interface specification, RTU I/O list and AGC test report for the project.

notes: Analysed core item from the owner-supplied equipment/facilities list for a 7-unit gas-engine power plant. Evidence categories present: sources, specifications, vendors, catalogue models. Checked for prices, projects, standards, patents, drawings and materials; where absent the gaps record says so.
